title: Workspace ONE to Intune Coexistence & Cutover Runbook
author_notes: Effort tier: T3 (operational runbook for running Workspace ONE and Intune in parallel during transition, with cutover/rollback procedures).
hook: Run Workspace ONE and Intune side by side — and cut over without chaos
problem: During a migration you inevitably run both MDMs at once, and that's where things break: devices double-managed, Conditional Access locking people out, and no clear go/no-go for cutover. This solution is the operational Workspace ONE to Intune coexistence and cutover runbook — how to run both platforms safely in parallel, the order of operations, go/no-go gates, the cutover sequence per device cohort, and a tested rollback — so the transition is controlled instead of chaotic.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the coexistence model (both MDMs live), the risks (double management, Conditional Access, app conflicts), the cutover sequence and go/no-go gates, and the rollback path.

Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (both MDM admin access, Entra ID/Conditional Access control, a device cohort plan, change control, a comms channel) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.

Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: establish coexistence guardrails, define cohort cutover order and go/no-go gates, execute a cohort cutover, validate, roll back if a gate fails, then repeat per cohort.

5 PowerShell scripts — coexistence/dual-management discovery, per-device cutover-readiness validation, a coexistence and cutover status report, safe remediation/rollback helper, and a cohort group builder.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.
short: The operational Workspace ONE to Intune coexistence and cutover runbook — how to run both platforms safely in parallel, the order of operations, go/no-go gates, the cutover sequence per cohort, and a tested rollback. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
